title: Crestline Credit Card Share of the Alignment Services & Plans Cancellation Processing Fee
content:
Holders of a Crestline Credit Card pay a share of the processing fee deducted from the refund of a cancelled Alignment Services & Plans plan. The processing fee is multiplied by the cardholder fee share, read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the 12 calendar months up to the cancellation.

| Customer's Crestline Credit Card account | Late fee posted in the 12 calendar months up to the cancellation | Cardholder fee share |
|---|---|---|
| Active | none | 0.50 (50%) |
| Active | one or more | 0.75 (75%) |
| No active account | — | 1.00 (100%) |

*Hypothetical fees:* a processing fee of 10.00 becomes 5.00 for an active account with no late fee in the period and 7.50 for an active account with a late fee in the period; a fee of 0.00 stays 0.00.
